halfLife.notes: Long parent half-life. Combined with norfluoxetine metabolite, effective washout takes weeks. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: Norfluoxetine
activeMetabolite.notes: Norfluoxetine has a 7-15 day half-life and meaningful SRI activity. This is the reason fluoxetine requires a 5-week (35-day) washout before any MAOI. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Potent CYP2D6 inhibition can substantially raise levels of drugs metabolised by CYP2D6 (e.g. venlafaxine, paroxetine, atomoxetine, codeine). Effects persist for weeks after fluoxetine cessation due to the long metabolite. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

maoiWashout.notes: FIVE WEEKS off fluoxetine before starting any MAOI. This is non-negotiable due to norfluoxetine's long half-life. Standard 14 days off MAOI before starting fluoxetine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Discontinuation symptoms uncommon due to the long auto-tapering effect of norfluoxetine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Capsules and tablets available in Malaysia. Liquid formulation availability is limited. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
